NTF: Without any new information from the user on how the unit was oriented the system failure has been root caused and liquid ingress due to suspected in-correct orientation is believed to be the reason for this failure mode. The issue was reproduced and the results were similar to the field returned unit where liquid was slowly introduced with the unit kept upside down. FTIR was also done to identify foreign residues in the returned unit and is confirmed to be a product of the liquid ingress. PD team is confident that the m22 gland design does not need any update and IP66 testing is accurate for Snowbird's use case. The team is confident that in the correct orientation of Snowbird with proper tightening of the m22 gland and with the help of gravity unit should be safe from liquid ingress. We will continue to monitor field returns for any more liquid ingress failure modes
